feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 October 2026 4:18pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 11 October 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure will decline later today as a complex area of low pressure in the Atlantic drives frontal troughs across the area overnight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

South or southeast 2 to 4, backing southeast 5 or 6 later this evening, veering south or southeast 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then occasional rain or drizzle soon arriving. Areas of mist and isolated fog patches later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/drizzle/mist. Very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 through the evening, veering west or southwest 4 to 6 overnight into Tuesday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon building moderate or rough, then slight or moderate again later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain/drizzle/mist clearing to isolated showers later. Small risk of fog patches until later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/drizzle/mist. Very poor in any fog patches.
